metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2024 · Lucky Baskhar

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Eleven
metas.description: A brave and skilled officer with a strong record of solving tough cases is assigned to a new, more challenging serial killing investigation.

metas.name: ★ 9.0 · 2025 · Unpaarvayil
metas.description: When tragedy strikes twice, Bhavya refuses to remain a victim. Visually impaired, she is drawn into a perilous hunt for the truth behind the mysterious deaths of her husband & twin sister - uncovering a dark world where nothing is as it seems.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2026 · Rao Bahadur

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2024 · Zebra
metas.description: A group of white collar fraudsters become entangled with a vicious criminal as they plan an audacious heist.

metas.description: The story revolves around victims who have been brutally raped, murdered and then burnt using Kerosene. While investigating the case, Vaibhav comes across a few more cases with the same Modus Operandi committed.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · Raju Gari Ammayi Naidu Gari Abbayi
metas.description: Raju Garu and Naidu Garu are big wigs of the village. Their children Anu and Karna are in love. However, things take a tragic turn when Anu's body is found in the Godavari river.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2024 · Brahmavaram PS Paridilo
metas.description: A headless body found near the police station in Brahmmavaram. It follows the mystery of whose body it is, who the killer is, and why the body was left there. What mistake it is and how sometimes mistakes bring Justice ???

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2024 · Viraaji
metas.description: A stand-up comic, gynecologist, hotel manager, police officer and a drug addict, among others reach an abandoned mental asylum by a mysterious host, who informs them that they would all be dead by dawn for their past sins and proceeds killing. Will they live to see another day?

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2023 · Rajugari Kodipulao
metas.description: A group of friends ended up hopelessly in a deep forest during their reunion trip. Were they spookily haunted by a monstrous animal with a mischievous sense of humor, or was the monster just one of them, trying to scare the rest silly?

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2024 · Srikakulam Sherlockholmes
metas.description: A string of beach murders rocks a coastal town, prompting police to hire a meticulous private eye. His investigation zeroes in on seven suspects, including a village couple, after a young girl's killing sparks public outcry.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2024 · KA
metas.description: In a village where the sun sinks below the horizon by 3 PM, darkness creeps in early, bringing with it a chilling wave of inexplicable horrors.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Beauty
metas.description: A moving and suspenseful tale of a father`s unshakable love. When his daughter suddenly goes missing, his world is turned upside down. What begins as a desperate search soon becomes a gripping journey filled with questions of trust, innocence, and the true meaning of unconditional love. A film that belongs to everyone, Beauty explores a parent`s relentless hope and the lengths they will go to for their child.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2024 · Mukhya Gamanika
metas.description: A young constable stumbles into a deadly maze. The tragic murder of his father, coinciding with the disappearance of a husband, ignites a chase for the truth, forcing him to confront hidden dangers and protect what's dear.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2025 · Anaganaga Australia Lo
metas.description: An Indian former Chief Minister receives a high-stakes call from Melbourne, Australia, demanding a ransom of 100 crores in exchange for a top-secret that could jeopardize their political party's future with elections around the corner.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2025 · Artiste
metas.description: A serial killer wreaks havoc across a town, leading a bereaved man to seek retribution.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2024 · Nindha
metas.description: Follows six murder case suspects who get kidnapped and an officer's quest to find the truth

metas.name: ★ 9.2 · 2026 · Dharmasthala Niyojakavargam
metas.description: Grief-stricken father sparks revolution after principled son's murder by corrupt MLA's drug empire
Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Trimukha
metas.description: When trying to solve unsolved serial killings, CID officer Shivani Rathod (Sunny leone) faces all dead ends. In a parallel screenplay, Hero (Yogesh) and team are detectives that tries to solve paranormal cases and untie horror incidents. After series of complex incidents both CID Shivani's police team as well as Hero Yogi's team fails in their respective missions. How do these two completely unknown and separate teams get connected ? Who is the serial killer that CID Shivani Rathod is looking for ? Does Hero Yogi and team succeed in solving unexplainable mysterious paranormal incidents involving ghosts and supernatural objects ?

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2024 · Preminchoddu : Don't Love
metas.description: Lalasa, teenage girl from a slum,Polytechnic student, knows nothing about the outside world, got attracted to Kamal and Saaras, men who are much older to her. An eye-opener for Teenagers, who are unable to differentiate Love and Attraction

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2024 · Operation Raavan

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2024 · Bahirbhoomi

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2025 · LYF: Love Your Father
metas.description: A beautiful father-son duo navigates love, betrayal, and redemption amidst a betting mafia and police chase, unveiling a heartfelt journey of debts and dreams.
